newsitem.title: INDONESIA: BAPEPAM TO CELEBRATE 20TH ANNIVERSARY NEXT WEEK.
newsitem.headline: BAPEPAM TO CELEBRATE 20TH ANNIVERSARY NEXT WEEK.

text.p: Indonesia's Capital Market Supervisory Agency will celebrate the 20th annivesary of its founding with a series of special activities, including a conference, its chairman I Putu Gede Ary Suta said on Thursday.

The two-day international conference will be opened by President Suharto at the Jakarta Convention Centre on August 14 with around 1,100 people expected to attend, Ary Suta told an afternoon news conference.

"The aim of holding this conference is to raise the role of national investors in supporting the development of the Indonesia capital markets to become one of the best in Asia," he said reading a statement.
The anniversary celebrations will also include an exhibition, gala dinner, sporting events and community service work, he added.
Ary Suta did not comment during the news conference on activities on the stock market, which fell 3.13 percent on Thursday.
